actionable_tips: For Naver stock workflows, navigate directly to https://search.naver.com/search.naver?query={{company_name}} 주가 instead of driving the Naver home search box.
Wait for 증권정보, 현재가, and ticker markers before extracting body text.
Prefer the naver_stock.extract_stock_card handler; do not hand-scrape volatile price nodes unless the handler is missing.
content.assertion_strategy: Assert company_name, ticker, current_price, and report_text fields; avoid exact price equality because market text changes.
failure_modes: Naver card can be absent if query is ambiguous.
Current price and market status are volatile.
content.selector_strategy: Text markers and handler extraction before CSS selectors.

summary: Use direct Naver stock search plus handler extraction for stock report workflows.

actionable_tips: Headed Naver Map runs must enter eval-and-evolve/browser evaluation; static page_text can be empty before hydration.
Store route endpoints as generic arguments start_station and end_station, plus optional start_url.
Prefer naver_map.extract_subway_duration after the transit result panel is visible.
content.assertion_strategy: Look for transit mode and duration/result markers, then assert structured duration output instead of exact UI text.
failure_modes: Initial body text may not contain 출발지 입력 or 도착지 입력.
Map route UI can render late after scripts load.
Keyboard focus can land in map canvas unless input selection is explicit.
content.selector_strategy: Browser-evaluated input interaction and stable Korean mode markers.

summary: Treat Naver Map transit routes as hydrated browser tasks, not static text tasks.

actionable_tips: When a page can include iframes or hydrated app shells, store frame_hints separately from framework_hints.
Capture stable wait markers, extraction strategy, selector strategy, and risk notes together; generic labels like react or iframe are not enough.
Evidence excerpts should be short and contain the actual text markers used by the future workflow.
content.assertion_strategy: Each page analysis should name at least two stable markers or explain why markers are not available.
failure_modes: A page analysis that only says framework=react does not help generation.
Query strings must not create duplicate memory rows for the same page.
content.selector_strategy: Prefer role/label/text selectors first, then test ids, then CSS only when stable.

summary: Page analysis entries should be actionable enough to guide the next script.

actionable_tips: For simple login forms, prefer label and role selectors before CSS selectors.
After submitting, assert a destination marker such as Secure Area plus a success message, not only URL navigation.
Keep credentials as workflow arguments so QA examples can be reapplied without editing generated steps.
content.assertion_strategy: Assert visible success marker and current route/path context.
failure_modes: Flash messages can include close button text and whitespace differences.
A successful URL change without success text can hide failed form submission.
content.selector_strategy: get_by_label for inputs and get_by_role(button) for submit.

summary: Login workflows should use label/role selectors and assert visible success text.
